cover.title: The six-week decay
cover.sub: How automation quietly de-skills your best team

points.label: The slow slide
points.head: The team got quietly worse
points.body: We automated triage. Fewer people woken, the numbers looked great. Then a novel fault arrived and they stalled.

points.label: The real cause
points.head: You took away their reps
points.body: Every routine incident was a small rep. Automate the boring reps away and the edge goes with them.

points.label: The wrong number
points.head: Watch what you could not automate
points.body: Not how well you handle the incidents you automated. How well you handle the ones you could not.

points.label: The fix
points.head: Put the reps back on purpose
points.body: Run one live incident drill the automation cannot help with. A novel fault, no runbook, your best people, cold.

cta.head: Keep your team's edge on purpose.
